title: DivAlgo: A systematic evaluation of algorithmic diversity for code generation models
title_zh: DivAlgo：对代码生成模型算法多样性的系统性评估

paragraphs.en: DivAlgo 是一个评估代码生成模型算法多样性的基准测试，发现大多数模型生成的代码多样性远低于人类。 Code generation models are actively being used in professional and educational settings. However, the competence of large language models (LLMs) to generate algorithmically diverse code remains largely unknown. We propose the DivAlgo benchmark, a large-scale dataset constituting algorithmically diverse solutions to programming problems. We also introduce a lightweight similarity metric to enable large-scale evaluation. Our experiments across 24 modern code generation models found that uncontrolled model-generated code is significantly less diverse than human solutions (capturing ~31% of human diversity), and even the best diverse code generation strategy could achieve only ~70% of human diversity. Moreover, while it was possible to steer the models to generate solutions based on human strategies, they were unable to reproduce the diversity of the human solutions. These findings indicate the limitations of code generation models in capturing the algorithmic diversity humans exhibit, and that overexposure to model-generated code can narrow programmers' algorithmic vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: DivAlgo 是一个用于评估代码生成模型算法多样性的基准测试，研究发现大多数模型生成的代码多样性远低于人类。代码生成模型正被广泛应用于专业和教学环境中。 然而，大型语言模型（LLM）在生成具有算法多样性的代码方面的能力在很大程度上仍不为人所知。 我们提出了 DivAlgo 基准测试，这是一个由解决编程问题的多样化算法方案组成的大规模数据集。 我们还引入了一种轻量级的相似性度量方法，以实现大规模评估。 我们对 24 种现代代码生成模型进行的实验发现，未经控制的模型生成代码的多样性显著低于人类解决方案（仅涵盖了人类多样性的约 31%），即便是最多样化的代码生成策略，也仅能达到人类多样性的约 70%。 此外，尽管可以通过引导模型来生成基于人类策略的解决方案，但它们却无法再现人类解决方案所展现的多样性。 这些发现表明，代码生成模型在捕捉人类所展现的算法多样性方面存在局限性，并且过度接触模型生成的代码可能会限制程序员的算法词汇量。
